name: Kaidan Alenko
prompt: Create one isolated full-length portrait of Kaidan Alenko, the fictional adult character shown in the two official Mass Effect costume-reference images. Use the reference face and the same blue-and-black armor with narrow paired white stripes, high collar, black undersuit, gloves, belt, blue thigh plates and blue shin guards. Keep the garment arrangement and small details from the supplied references. Kaidan stands calmly, body turned three quarters toward the right side of the image, looking right, hands relaxed at his sides and both feet visible. A single figure from the top of the hair to the bottom of the boots, with generous empty space on every side. Realistic game-character illustration, even studio lighting, clear materials and silhouette. No equipment held in the hands, no visual effects, no background scenery, no floor, no captions, no extra figures. Transparent alpha background.

name: Miranda Lawson
prompt: Create ONE full-length isolated character concept of MIRANDA LAWSON, the fictional adult Mass Effect character shown in these official EA/BioWare costume guides. The images are identity and costume references, not a collage layout. Keep her recognizable face, blue eyes, medium brown shoulder-length hair and adult athletic proportions. Reproduce exactly the reference white/lavender hexagonal-pattern suit, fitted black shoulder-and-arm jacket sections with the two small silver Cerberus marks, white raised neck edges with black neck band, black gloves with white finger sections, the asymmetrical black-and-silver double hip strap arrangement, and tall black heeled boots with their angular knee sections and silver hardware. Maintain the exact white/black panel boundaries, hexagon texture scale and reference garment seams, without substituting generic armor. Pose: a restrained low ready stance for a 2.5D fighting-game concept, face and torso turned three quarters toward SCREEN RIGHT, gaze right, arms held naturally slightly away from the torso, hands relaxed and readable, feet individually visible and grounded, no exaggerated gesture. All hair, hands and boot heels must fit comfortably inside the frame. The complete character occupies no more than eighty-two percent of the total canvas height with at least nine percent EMPTY SPACE above and below. Preserve reference body proportions. Clean realistic game-character rendering, soft neutral studio illumination, detailed material surfaces and crisp silhouette. One individual, one view only. No weapon, glow, attack effect, floor, scenery, cast ground shadow, caption, frame or additional logo. TRUE transparent alpha background. Do not copy the colorful reference background. Do not put checkerboard pixels behind the figure.

name: Jacob Taylor
prompt: Create exactly ONE full-length cutout of JACOB TAYLOR, the fictional adult Mass Effect character in the two official EA/BioWare reference guides. Reference identity and costume are the source of truth. Preserve his recognizable face, dark brown skin, closely cropped dark hair, subtle mustache/goatee and muscular but realistic adult human proportions. Exact reference suit: high black collar edged in silver-white with small rectangular fittings; fitted black/charcoal armor over a hex-textured black undersuit; dark blue-black sculpted pectoral sections, long white side-torso panels continuing into the outer upper thighs, central dark honeycomb material and vertical zipper motif; blocky gray upper-arm and forearm plates; articulated black gloves; black belt with the distinctive central silver geometric buckle; angular dark knee and shin armor and black armored boots. Preserve the precise panel boundaries and reference silver piping. Do not add an N7 logo, change the armor to all-black, or invent bulky shoulder pads or gadgets. Show one character facing SCREEN RIGHT in a composed low combat-ready posture: torso three-quarter profile, head looking right, bent elbows with hands clear of the chest, knees only subtly flexed, feet separated and completely visible. The entire character from hair through boot soles takes at most eighty-two percent of canvas height, with at least nine percent empty transparent space both above the head and below the feet, plus comfortable side margins. Neutral focused face, realistic in-game visual finish, softly balanced neutral lighting, faithful black/white material contrast and crisp cutout silhouette. ONE individual and ONE view, not a turnaround or sheet. No weapon, no glow or effect, no floor, no scenery, no ground shadow, no border, no text. TRUE transparent alpha background, without checkerboard pixels and without the guide background.
